name: triad-chess-game
description: A three-player hex-board chess game with local AI and multiplayer support.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client "npm run dev --workspace=@triad-chess/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@triad-chess/client"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client "npm run start --workspace=@triad-chess/server" "npm run preview --workspace=@triad-chess/client -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
